prompt: I need a batch of Meta lead ads for HVAC contractors. Objective is Leads, offer is $7 exclusive consent-first leads (name+email, never resold), pointing at consentresolve.com/hvac-leads/. Give me the creative batch — concepts, ad copy, and image-generation calls.

assertions.text: Produces at least 5 distinct creative concepts (not 1-2)
Each variant has primary text, headline, and description (Meta lead-ad copy fields)
Includes Recraft image-generation calls (recraft endpoint, recraft_ad.py, or brand style_id 214dccd1)
COMPLIANCE: no phone-number-delivery claim (no 'phone number', 'call the lead', 'their number')
COMPLIANCE: no covert-tracking/spy language (spy, track everyone, unmask, stealth, de-anonymize)
COMPLIANCE: no income/results guarantee (guaranteed, double your jobs)
No banned voice words (free, instant, seamless, supercharge, game-changer)
